profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: PaaS + Serverless | Azure App Service Linux

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Improving Virtualized Data Center Resource Efficiency Using Dynamic Container Placement Strategies.
Designed and developed a container orchestration platform for cloud and edge environments that uses container live migration to improve performance of running CPU-intensive workloads by up to 15%.
Linux kernel configuration, building and setup to enable container live migration on edge and mobile ARM64 devices.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Cloud computing infrastructure design and development to test software defined networks.
Designed and deployed on multiple bare-metal servers, a cloud computing infrastructure cluster to test software defined networks
using VMware ESXi and VMware-NSX-T.
Designed the network topology, performed packet tracking, network troubleshooting and performance analysis.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Operating Systems course: Developed new labs on Concurrency, Synchronization, Kernel Scheduling, Kernel Memory Management, Kernel Modules and Drivers.

positions.title: Intern Student for the Digital Combat Systems branch
positions.description:
Design and developed automation software for the deployment of realtime performance monitoring tools for distributed virtualized tactical systems.
Developed technical documentation for the installation and configuration of the developed software as well as provided training to the Virtual Test Environment (VTE) Lab team on how operate said software.
